import gc
import sys
import weakref
import time

sys.path.insert(0, '/home/lwx/recsys-examples/corelib/dynamicemb/test/unit_tests')
import torch
from dynamicemb import DynamicEmbPoolingMode
from test_no_grad_slot_lifetime import make_model, batch

layout = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'hbm'
model, _ = make_model(DynamicEmbPoolingMode.NONE, layout)
keys, offsets = batch(0)
model(keys, offsets).sum().backward()
model.eval()
source, consumer = torch.cuda.Stream(), torch.cuda.Stream()
torch.cuda.synchronize()
with torch.cuda.stream(source):
    warm_state = model.resolve_input(keys, offsets)
source.synchronize()
with torch.cuda.stream(consumer):
    warm_output = model(keys, offsets, prefetch_state=warm_state)
consumer.synchronize()
expected = warm_output.cpu()
shape, dtype = warm_state.unique_values.shape, warm_state.unique_values.dtype
del warm_state, warm_output
with torch.cuda.stream(source):
    warm_allocs = [torch.full(shape, 7777, device=keys.device, dtype=dtype) for _ in range(64)]
source.synchronize()
del warm_allocs
with torch.cuda.stream(source):
    state = model.resolve_input(keys, offsets)
source.synchronize()
# Isolate value lifetime from index lifetime; avoid poisoning any index tensor.
other_metadata = [v for name, v in vars(state).items() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) and name != 'unique_values']
state_ref = weakref.ref(state)
values_ref = weakref.ref(state.unique_values)
ptr = state.unique_values.data_ptr()
with torch.cuda.stream(consumer):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    torch.cuda._sleep(1_000_000_000)
    output = model(keys, offsets, prefetch_state=state)
    done = torch.cuda.Event()
    done.record()
print('FORWARD_TIME', time.perf_counter() - start, 'DONE', done.query(), flush=True)
del state
print('DROPPED', state_ref() is None, values_ref() is None, 'PTR', ptr, flush=True)
with torch.cuda.stream(source):
    reuse = [torch.full(shape, 7777, device=keys.device, dtype=dtype) for _ in range(64)]
source.synchronize()
print('REUSED', ptr in [v.data_ptr() for v in reuse], 'DONE', done.query(), flush=True)
